macros.title: Account deletion request - closure and break options
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

I understand you'd like your account removed. Complete account deletion isn't possible due to legal and compliance obligations, as we're required to retain certain data. What we can offer is account closure: once closed, your account becomes inaccessible, you can no longer use any services on our platform, and you're removed from all marketing communications. You can read how it works here: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/10763642-closing-your-account

If you'd like to step away from gambling, self-exclusion indefinitely suspends access to your account (https://help.stake.com/en/articles/4793477-self-exclusion-and-account-closure), or you can take a shorter Break-In-Play (https://help.stake.com/en/articles/9874126-break-in-play).

5. Click the link in the email we send you to finish enabling 2FA.

Please never share your QR code or the string with anyone. Guide: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/5222651-how-to-set-up-your-two-factor-authentication-2fa-to-your-account

macros.title: Affiliate Commission Calculation
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

The standard affiliate commission is 10%, but the amount you receive depends on the house edge of the games your referred players enjoy. These formulas are used:
1. Casino: house edge as decimal x wagered / 2 x commission rate
2. Sportsbook (3% theoretical house edge): 0.03 x wagered / 2 x commission rate
3. Poker: rake x commission rate (rake is the small percentage of each poker pot collected as a hosting fee)

You can check your commission payout here: https://stake.com/affiliate/commission
Full details: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/9995651-how-to-get-an-affiliate-commission-with-stake

Pre-monthly and post-monthly bonuses may also be sent before or after the monthly bonus, but they aren't guaranteed each month and occur at random. Also, claiming your monthly bonus in crypto gives you more value compared to other currency options.

macros.title: Asian Total Settlement: Void and Half Win
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Thanks for your message about bet {{bet_id}}. On Asian Total markets with a whole-number line, the bet is void if the total goals equal the line. For example, an Over/Under 3 goals bet is void at odds of x1 if the match ends with exactly 3 goals.

Quarter lines (.25/.75) split your wagered amount in half between the nearest whole and half lines, so the result can be a Win, Half Win, Half Loss, or Loss. For example, Over 2.75 is split between Over 2.5 and Over 3: it is fully won with at least 4 goals, and if exactly 3 goals are scored, it settles as a Half Win.

More details: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/5086225-how-do-asian-totals-work

macros.title: Selfie with ID - Step-by-Step Tips
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},

Here is how to take a selfie with your identity document so it can be reviewed:
1. Make sure your ID is clean and free of any glare or shadows, and stand in front of a well-lit background, preferably with natural light.
2. Hold your ID in one hand next to your face without covering your face, so we can clearly see both your face and the ID.
3. Look straight at the camera, avoid accessories (e.g. sunglasses, a hat, headband, glasses) and do not use flash.
4. Keep your hand steady to prevent blurry images, and make sure the document is not flipped or mirrored.
5. The photo must be in colour and high resolution, in an image format like JPG or PNG (compressed zip files are not accepted).

Full guide: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/7916730-taking-a-selfie-with-an-identity-document-a-step-by-step-guide

macros.title: VIP Progress: How to Calculate What's Left to the Next Level
macros.body:
Hi {{user}},
You can see your current VIP progress percentage on the homepage once you're logged in. Here's how to work out what's left until your next level (example: Bronze at 45%):
1. Subtract your current level requirement from the next level's requirement: $50,000 - $10,000 = $40,000.
2. Multiply your progress percentage by that amount and divide by 100 to get what you've wagered so far: 45 x $40,000 / 100 = $18,000.
3. Subtract that from the requirement to see what's left: $40,000 - $18,000 = $22,000.
Sports bets count 3x more, so for sports you can divide the remaining amount by 3. If you mix sports and casino bets, your transaction history shows your total wagered. More details: https://help.stake.com/en/articles/4974712-how-to-calculate-your-vip-progress

Depositing and then withdrawing without placing any bets is treated as coin mixing, and such a withdrawal will be invalid. Please only ever play with amounts you are comfortable with.
